g.text: Local storage first, then sync when the network returns.
Field conditions are the default, not the edge case.
Sensitive data stays on the device, encrypted wherever
it has to sync. No trackers, no pointless accounts.
True RTL layouts, Arabic-aware search and matching,
dialect support and Arabic typography from screen one.
Self-test routes and CI builds, and READMEs that state
their limits and risks openly instead of hiding them.
